questions.q: How many surahs are there in the Quran?
questions.explain: The Quran has thirty juz and one hundred and fourteen surahs.

questions.q: Over how many years was the Quran revealed?
questions.explain: The Quran was revealed in Arabic over 23 years.

questions.q: Who collected the Quran after the Prophet SAW died?
questions.explain: Abu Bakr, the first caliph, collected the Quran after the Prophet SAW died.
Ummi means unable to read and write, like a newborn baby.

options: A clot that clings in the womb
questions.explain: Alaq is a clot of blood clinging in the womb, like a leech.

options: The Lord who creates, owns and sustains
questions.explain: Rabb is the Lord who creates and keeps caring for His servant until death.

questions.q: Which prophet was the first to write, taught by Allah with the pen?
questions.explain: Prophet Idris was taught by Allah to write with the pen.

questions.q: How many embraces did Jibril give before delivering the first five verses of Al-Alaq?
questions.explain: On the third time Jibril delivered the first verses of Al-Alaq.

questions.q: Nobody can change a letter, word or surah in the Quran, because Allah preserves it.
questions.explain: True. The Quran is protected by Allah.

questions.q: We may stop learning once we are old.
questions.explain: False. The fifth verse of Al-Alaq teaches us to learn throughout life.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The first five verses of Al-Alaq are delivered

questions.explain: True dreams began, Jibril embraced him, and then the first verses were delivered.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Read, gathering letters into words and verses
One of the 30 parts of the Quran

questions.explain: A juz is one of 30 parts, the basmalah is the Bismillah, iqra' means read, and alaq is a clinging clot.
